cases.question: What text is written in the image? Reply with the text only.
cases.notes: large printed text: the baseline OCR case

cases.question: What is the order number and what is the total? Reply briefly.
cases.notes: small printed text lines: resolution test, a bigger grid helps (16x16 loses it)

cases.question: How many squares are there? Answer with a number.
cases.notes: five blue squares in a row

cases.question: Which color is on the left? Answer with one word.
cases.notes: red square left, green square right

cases.question: Which bar is the tallest? Answer with the letter only.
cases.notes: bars A B C D, D is the tallest

cases.question: What word is written on the banner? Reply with the word only.
cases.notes: 3:1 wide banner: tests the aspect-ratio preset choice

cases.question: What shape is this and what color is it?
cases.notes: 1:2 tall image with a green triangle

cases.question: What is the TOTAL on this order? Reply with the number only.
cases.notes: square slip with 11 px text: readable from 24x24 on, expected to FAIL at detail low (16x16): tells the detail levels apart
